name: Chestnut green rice
summary: Cốm hạt dẻ is young Pì Pất rice cut while still milky, boiled, dried, and pounded to a translucent green, then rubbed with pounded chestnut. The taste is the nuttiness of both.
origin: Trung Khanh, on the eastern road.
howToEat: Eat it by the handful in autumn, when the rice is still milky and the chestnut is in.
where: Trung Khanh, on the eastern road, in autumn.
